source: NHTSA Vehicle Crash Test Database (public domain, US government)
summary: The same left oblique on a 2014 Camry (1,734 kg), RMDB 2,490.2 kg at 89.69 km/h (report R002 p.3, p.7, p.9). Films: 1000 fps everywhere (onboard too, report data sheet 6), first contact at frame 48-51 depending on the camera (captions). This test alone has angular rate sensors: the car yaws nose-right to +2.9 deg at 50 ms, then nose-left, -4.9 deg at 150 ms and -14.8 deg at 290 ms. Crush 561 mm at C1, bumper beam 538 mm at B2, left wheelbase -170 mm, RMDB 277 mm. Proposed Rubble setup as 9124.
